name: standings
title: Standings
description: The board between rounds of a live game: who is where now, and how they got there. Each player's points from this round pop up beside their name, their total counts up from where it was, and then the rows glide to their new places, with the places gained…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/standings

Installed to `components/ui/games/standings.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/standings';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/standings

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
